153.04400,-27.55900.name: Queensland Health Forensic Scientific Services (QHFSS)
153.04400,-27.55900.state: 39 Kessels Road, Coopers Plains QLD 4108, Australia
153.04400,-27.55900.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Queensland Department of Health (State Government). It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Containment space: 150 SqM. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

12.49640,41.90280.name: FAO — biotechnology and biosafety
12.49640,41.90280.desc: The UN food agency’s biotechnology work, including capacity-building for national biosafety systems in countries without them. Which countries get a functioning regulator, and on whose model, is decided substantially through programmes like this one.

12.49640,41.90280.name: Codex Alimentarius — foods derived from biotechnology
12.49640,41.90280.desc: The UN food standards body's guidance on assessing engineered foods, agreed in 2003 after four years of negotiation. Codex texts are not binding, but the WTO treats them as the reference for whether a country's food safety measure is justified — so a voluntary standard becomes the test by which a trade restriction stands or falls, and that is where a national labelling rule is actually decided.

-106.60000,52.10000.name: Triffid flax — deregistered line found in exports a decade later
-106.60000,52.10000.size: Canadian flax exports to the EU
-106.60000,52.10000.desc: A flax variety deregistered in Canada in 2001 to protect European exports appeared in European shipments a decade later. Deregistration removed the paperwork; it did not remove the seed, which persisted in the system long after the record said it was gone.

-122.46600,37.77000.name: iNaturalist — recording where a plant actually was
-122.46600,37.77000.state: San Francisco — California Academy of Sciences
-122.46600,37.77000.desc: A dated, located, photographed observation, held publicly and permanently by somebody other than you. That is what turns a volunteer plant in a ditch from a thing you saw into a record that can be cited, checked and counted with everybody else’s. It cannot identify an engineered plant — nothing visual can — but it fixes the species, the place and the date, which is the part a strip test does not give you and the part a complaint needs. Photograph the plant, note the trait if you tested, and say so in the description.
